securityNotes: Read SKILL.md, design-systems/interop-protocol.md and design-systems/crosswalk.md in full at the pinned SHA: plain reference documentation (a six-axis crosswalk method; per-system notes for Material 3, Apple HIG, Fluent 2, Carbon, shadcn/ui, Radix, Ant, Polaris, Primer, Atlassian, Bootstrap), no hidden instructions or injection content, no reference to any private/undeclared service. scripts/contrast.py already reviewed (pure local hex-contrast calculator).

proposedEntry.name: migrate-design-system
proposedEntry.description: Bridges this project's token system to or from any external design system (Material Design 3, Apple HIG, Fluent, Carbon, Ant, shadcn/ui, Radix, Chakra, Mantine, Bootstrap, and more) via a role-based, six-axis crosswalk (color roles, type scale, spacing unit, radius, elevation, motion) rather than name-matching. Supports three directions: adopting an external system's look by re-pointing the project's semantic tokens, theming an external component library on top of the project's own tokens, or migrating between systems through an audit-map-bridge-verify sequence applied screen by screen. Every mapped color pair is re-checked for WCAG contrast and all eight component states plus dark mode are confirmed to survive the mapping before the crosswalk table and bridge plan are handed off.
triggers: theme Radix primitives with our tokens
map our tokens to Apple HIG
inputs: The target external design system or component library
outputs: A crosswalk table (our token -> their token -> value note)
A bridge/migration plan if migrating between systems
Verified token overrides with contrast and state coverage confirmed
